title: Natural-degree scalar external Cech cup compatibility
statement: For schemes X and Y over a field k, quasicoherent coefficient modules F and G, covering families U and V with iSup U = top and iSup V = top, a cochain map c whose components are the front/back external Cech pairing, and canonical scalar Cech comparison maps eX, eY and eP in every degree, let a and b be factor cycles in degrees p and q, with p+q=n. If the inclusion of a total-tensor cycle z in degree n is the (p,q)-summand inclusion of a tensor b, then (-1)^(p*q) times eP_n(H(c)([z])) equals externalCup(eX_p([a]), eY_q([b])), transported from degree p+q to n. No comparison map is assumed to be an isomorphism. Definitions and comparison data: [def-weil-field], [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-coherent], [lem-sc-picard-scalar-cech-comparison], [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models], [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-component].

proof.text: Apply the signed core comparison with the supplied cover, cochain map, comparison witnesses and cycles. All hypotheses and the integer sign agree definitionally.

lean.statement:
theorem picardScalarCech_externalCup
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤)
    (c : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
        ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶
      (picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hc : IsPicardExternalCechCupComponent f g U V F G c)
    (eX : ∀ p : ℕ, ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).homology p →ₗ[k]
      scalarCohomology f F p)
    (heX : ∀ p, IsPicardScalarCechComparison f U F p (eX p))
    (eY : ∀ q : ℕ, ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).homology q →ₗ[k]
      scalarCohomology g G q)
    (heY : ∀ q, IsPicardScalarCechComparison g V G q (eY q))
    (eP : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology n →ₗ[k]
        scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n)
    (heP : ∀ n, IsPicardScalarCechComparison (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n (eP n)) :
    let A := (picardCechFunctor f U).obj F
    let B := (picardCechFunctor g V).obj G
    let T := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
      (a : A.cycles i.val.1) (v : B.cycles i.val.2) (z : T.cycles n),
      T.iCycles n z =
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) i.val.1 i.val.2 n i.property
            ((A.iCycles i.val.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles i.val.2 v)) →
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val.1 * i.val.2) •
          eP n (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c n (T.homologyπ n z)) =
        cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property)
          (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2
            (eX i.val.1 (A.homologyπ _ a)) (eY i.val.2 (B.homologyπ _ v)))

statement_change.old_statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $F,G$ quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent], and $U,V$ arbitrary open covers. Let $A,B$ be their scalar Cech complexes and $P$ the scalar Cech complex for $F\boxtimes G$ on the product cover [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models, def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Suppose $c:\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_kB)\to P$ satisfies the external front/back coordinates [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-component]. Let $e_X,e_Y,e_P$ be degreewise $k$-linear maps to scalar cohomology satisfying IsPicardScalarCechComparison [lem-sc-picard-scalar-cech-comparison]. For $p+q=n$, factor cycles $a,v$, and a total cycle $z$ whose inclusion is the $(p,q)$-summand inclusion of the tensor of their inclusions, $e_P(H^n(c)([z]))$ is externalCup of $e_X([a])$ and $e_Y([v])$, transported along $p+q=n$. No affine assumptions, existence of comparisons, their invertibility, fixed resolution model or extension to integers enter this assertion.
statement_change.what: The unsigned comparison omitted the Koszul factor. scalarExtCup composes the left class first; the two shift orders differ by (-1)^(p*q). The existing private (1,1) rational single-complex calculation verifies a nonzero sign discrepancy. Insert the factor on the resolution or ordinary module-cup side; canonical Cech product comparisons carry it on their left side.

citers.note: Use is adapted with the explicit Koszul factor in this delivery; the upper existential comparison absorbs it by the explicit tensor-homology summand sign equivalence.
